== Title ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍衛兵</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">移動不可。＊攻撃中は戦闘力＝０、防御中は戦闘力＝４として扱う。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ゲイラン・トーグは、ヤヴィンの戦いの勝利を祝す記念式典の間、名誉ある衛兵の任務に選ばれた。任務に忠実で、称えられることもない反乱同盟軍の英雄たちの典型と言えよう。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Rebel Guard]].

'''Lore''' — Gailan Torg was chosen for honorary guard duty during the ceremony celebrating victory in the Battle of Yavin. Faithful to the duty, he is typical of the unsung heroes of the Rebel Alliance.

'''Game text''' — Cannot move. *Treat power as 0 while attacking and as 4 while defending.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Name prints ゲイラン・トーグ, not Galen. Lore says faithful and unsung, not hard-working. 攻撃中 / 防御中 vs an offensive battle / defending a battle. Game text restates ＊ with the power values.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-rebelguard-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Rebel Guard]].</ref>
